picks.what: The Vardar and both banks of the town, colored postcard (State Archives of North Macedonia)
picks.why: color, firmly dated general view along the river with the mountains behind

picks.what: The city center, the Stone Bridge and Mount Vodno, photograph
picks.why: sharp high view of Macedonia Square, the Stone Bridge over the Vardar and the Millennium Cross on Vodno

gaps: P0–P3: no candidates. P4: only #1 (1903), a small unnamed mosque behind a wall, not a city view.
notes: P5 alternative: #5, Austro-Hungarian war press office ‘Gesamtansicht der Stadt’ (1914–18), a gray but genuine-looking general view of the Ottoman town with minarets; the city name comes only from its Commons category. #3 is a fine old-town view with the clock tower and minarets but is dated only ‘20th century’; #2 and #4 likewise undated. If a P4 view is wanted at any cost, #1 (Nopcsa, 1903) is the only dated one.
